title: AIIS signature, schema 0.2
description: One AIIS detection signature. A signature is evaluated against one document (a page, a header set, a body); session or telemetry evaluated behaviour is out of scope for this format. Schema 0.2 replaces the free-form attack_class and technique_ids of schema 0.1 with a primary technique_id, a matrix attack_vector, a canonical attack_class or an exposure_class selected by category, and a provenance block.

schema_version.description: The schema this file conforms to. Always the string 0.2 for this schema.

id.description: Globally unique signature id: AIIS-<FAMILY>-<NAME>-<NN>. The family token is 3 to 12 upper-case letters and must be registered in schema/families.json; each name segment starts with a letter; NN is a two digit sequence. The file lives at signatures/<family lowercased>/<id>.yaml.

version.description: Semver of the signature itself. Incremented whenever the pattern or the technique fields change.

status.description: draft signatures are published for review; active signatures carry provenance. A retired signature is deleted from the corpus and recorded in retired-ids.yaml, so there is no deprecated status on a signature file.

category.description: injection matches an attack payload embedded in a document. exposure matches evidence that a host publicly reaches an AI component. Selects which classification fields are required; there is no default.

technique_id.description: The primary Agent Threat Matrix technique this signature evidences. Resolved against vendor/agent-threat-matrix/matrix.json.

related_technique_ids.description: Secondary techniques the same payload also evidences. Must not repeat the primary technique_id.

attack_vector.description: An attackClasses id from the Agent Threat Matrix (matrix.json). Required for injection; optional for exposure, where schema/exposure-classes.json documents the join from exposure_class.

attack_class.description: One of the ten canonical attack classes (canonical-classes.json). Required for injection and must be the class whose primary list carries technique_id. Forbidden for exposure.

exposure_class.description: The exposed component family, from schema/exposure-classes.json. Required for exposure, forbidden for injection. EXPOSURE-RAG-SERVICE, EXPOSURE-AI-COPILOT and EXPOSURE-TOOL-REGISTRY are reserved: they are valid values with no signature yet.

hma_check_ids.description: The HackMyAgent check from its taxonomy that detects the same payload family on local agent files, empty where none exists. Resolved against vendor/hackmyagent/check-ids.json.

evidence_tier.description: observed: the payload was seen on a live document. validated: the pattern was confirmed against samples and a false positive corpus. adapted: the pattern was derived from a published description of the component or payload.

source.description: Where the evidence comes from: a URL, a report identifier or a corpus name.

first_seen.description: The date the payload or component was first observed, ISO 8601 calendar date.

provenance.description: Evidence behind the signature. Required, with at least evidence_tier, when status is active. The validator warns when source or first_seen is absent on an active signature.

excluded_domains.description: Optional list of host regex patterns (anchored ^...$ by the engine at compile time). When a document's source domain matches any entry, the signature is skipped for that document.

exclude_emoji_tag_flags.description: When true, well-formed regional-indicator flag emoji (U+1F3F4 base + Tag characters + U+E007F terminator) are removed before counting Tag-block characters, so legitimate flags are not read as steganographic injection.
